generation: Exact weighted marginal distribution of existing OUTCOME_ALIGNED_FINAL_SCORE_KERNEL_V2; past-season OOF residuals and past-season tie rate only

calibrator.fit: scipy L-BFGS-B mean three-way negative log likelihood + 0.01*(a^2+log_b^2)
calibrator.failure_policy: Abort on unsuccessful fit; do not retune on test

production_refit: NONE; use identical 2020-2022 fit for subsequent research overlays
population: REG only, one observed home spread per game; exclude invalid lines/missing forecasts/unsupported kernel with ledger; no exclusions based on outcome or predicted edge

settlement.push: retain third outcome; binary scores exclude pushes only
settlement.ties: actual final ties graded through handicap, never coin-flipped

uncertainty.note: Three evaluation seasons limit season-bootstrap inference

market_policy: Historical line defines target; spread odds diagnostic only, absent from fit features. Quote timestamps unverified; not PIT market-edge certification.
isolation: Frozen model coefficients, mean forecasts, original draws unchanged. Separate distribution-calibration output, no forced consistency with original analytic winner head. No total or first-half calibration claim.
